questions.question: 1. Which of the following is the best description of a substring?

answers.a: A contiguous sequence of characters within a string.
answers.b: A sequence of characters that appear in the same order, but not necessarily contiguous.
answers.c: Any possible combination of the original set of characters in the string.

explanations.a: Correct. A substring is a contiguous sequence of characters within a string.
explanations.b: Incorrect. This describes a subsequence, not a substring.
explanations.c: Incorrect. This describes a subset, not a substring.

questions.question: 2. Which of the following is not a prefix of the string "algorithm"?

explanations.a: Incorrect. 'algo' starts from the first character, so it is a prefix.
explanations.b: Incorrect. The whole string is always a prefix of itself.
explanations.c: Incorrect. 'al' starts from the first character, so it is a prefix.
explanations.d: Correct. 'go' does not start from the first character, so it is not a prefix.

questions.question: 3. Which of the following is a suffix of the string "vlabs"?

explanations.a: Incorrect. 'vlab' is a prefix, not a suffix.
explanations.b: Correct. 'labs' ends at the last character, so it is a suffix.
explanations.c: Incorrect. 'lab' is a substring, but not a suffix.

questions.question: 4. Which of the following best describes the purpose of the LPS (Longest Prefix Suffix) array in the KMP algorithm?

answers.a: It stores the length of the longest prefix which is also a suffix for each prefix of the pattern.
answers.b: It stores the number of pattern occurrences in the text.
answers.c: It stores the indices where the pattern matches the text.
answers.d: It stores the ASCII values of the pattern characters.

explanations.a: Correct. The LPS array is used to avoid redundant comparisons in KMP.
explanations.b: Incorrect. The LPS array does not count occurrences.
explanations.c: Incorrect. The LPS array does not store match indices.
explanations.d: Incorrect. The LPS array is not related to ASCII values.

explanations.d: Incorrect. This is not quadratic recursion.

questions.question: 6. Which of the following is NOT a valid step in the KMP preprocessing phase?

answers.a: Initialize the LPS array to all zeros.
answers.b: Compare the pattern with itself to find prefixes and suffixes.
answers.d: Update the LPS value when a prefix matches a suffix.

explanations.a: Incorrect. Initializing the LPS array is a valid step.
explanations.b: Incorrect. Comparing the pattern with itself is part of LPS computation.
explanations.c: Correct. Sorting is not part of KMP preprocessing.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Updating LPS values is a valid step.
